safe_persistence_test_design.engine: Fresh sqlite+pysqlite:///:memory: with StaticPool; assert engine.url.database==:memory: before serving requests.
safe_persistence_test_design.dependency_boundary: Use existing compute_smoke_server/current_app fixtures as reference; override get_db/current_user on a distinct local app instance/port before API execution. Never load configuredDB data or point mutation browser routes at production.
safe_persistence_test_design.seed: Two distinct months,two units,two members with same display name,overlapping/out-of-scope sentinels,active+archived catalog definitions and existing duties.
safe_persistence_test_design.execution: One mutation suite owns the instance and unique seed; actual API normalise/review/save/cancel/delete/approve operations only. Client fault injection may fail readback while actual server mutation executes once.
safe_persistence_test_design.readback: Independent GET endpoint/directSQL to that already-asserted RAM engine verifies target IDs and unchanged sentinel rows/assignments; no broad fixture reset during another run.
safe_persistence_test_design.limits: Test-only harness orchestration,notbackend product changes or policy rewrites. Root authorization/scope must remain frontend-only.
